execution_order: world index then seed, one cell at a time, 10 s provider cooldown
holdout: worlds_v2_holdout is generated from master seed 20270920, a seed domain disjoint from worlds_v2 (20260903..20260926); no case digest, knob signature or seed label is shared; the pilot that tuned the schema and prompt ran only on worlds_v2
missingness_policy: an operational failure is typed missingness and is never rerun in place; eligibility requires operational failures under 10% of planned cells (7 of 72)
primary_endpoint: admission rate over worlds (a cell is admitted when the stack executes, every constraint check holds and financing funds), with a world-clustered bootstrap interval
sample_size_rationale: 24 worlds is the cluster count the pilot established as the effective sample; three seeds average within-world model variance (pilot median 2.6 billion cents on worlds completed twice) without adding clusters
secondary_endpoint: mean developer_equity_npv delta from the scripted reference over admitted cells, world-clustered bootstrap
seed_handling: the three seeds of a world are averaged within the world before worlds are treated as independent
stopping_rule: no early stop; the run ends when every planned cell holds a verified receipt or typed missingness, or the $15 ceiling is reached
